newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber files for equity offerings.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber files for equity offerings.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc filed on Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for public offerings of up to 7,859,175 common shares and up to 5,175,000 depositary shares.
The common shares will be sold by certain stockholders and include 1,025,109 shares that may be acquired by underwriters to cover any over-allotments, the company said.
The common shares could raise up to $254.9 million for the selling shareholders if sold at an estimated $32.4375 per share, according to the filing.

The depositary shares, which are being sold by the company, may produce proceeds of $167.86 million if sold at an estimated $32.4372, the filing showed. The depositary shares offering includes up to 750,000 shares that underwriters may acquire to cover over-allotments.
Each depositary share represents 1/100th of a share of series D preferred share and is convertiblle into common shares.
Both offerings will be made through a group of underwriters jointly led by Goldman, Sachs & Co and Salomon Bros Inc.
Brooks Fiber, a telecommunication services company based in Town and Country, Mo., will not receive proceeds from the sale by shareholders.
Proceeds from the company's depositary share offering will be used to expand the company's 40 networks by the end of 1997 and cover related initial operating losses.
The company said it has applied to have the depositary shares quoted on the Nasdaq market under the symbol "BEPTZ."
